quests.title: One small square
quests.ask: Write `fill_square()`: fill the square row by row, then end on the west side just below it, facing east.
quests.nudge: A square is short rows stacked. After each row, where must the robot be for the next one?

quests.title: Up to the next square
quests.ask: Write `next_square()`: from below a finished square, get to the top-left cell of the next square, past the empty column, facing east.
quests.nudge: Where does `fill_square()` begin? That's where `next_square()` has to leave the robot.

quests.title: Every square in a row
quests.ask: Repeat the pair of calls to fill every square, with one empty column between them.
quests.nudge: If a square comes out in the wrong place, look at where the call before it left the robot.
